about: Alice M. Yardum-Hunter, 2011-2012 Chair of the Immigration Section for the L.A. County Bar Association, has practiced business and other complex immigration law for more than 30 years. She was been listed in Super Lawyers every year since its inception in 2004 through 2017and served on its Blue Ribbon Panel in 2012. Alice is a former Commissioner, Board of Legal Specialization, California State Bar. In 2007, she was nominated as among the top 25 lawyers from 9,000 practicing in the San Fernando Valley. She is a member of the American Immigration Lawyers Association, for which she has been a conference speaker, edited two books: California Chapters Conference Handbook and Practice Before the Department of Labor and advocates for immigration reform with members of Congress, with some success in changing vote.
